request: Analyze GSE86338 for the paper (Dynamic transcriptome changes during adipose tissue energy expenditure reveal critical roles for long noncoding RNA regulators): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk polyA RNA-seq (Illumina HiSeq2000), mouse C57BL/6 male; each library = pooled RNA from 4 animals (S4.2.p1)
final.primary_estimand: Effect of a swimming exercise program (ramp 10->90 min twice daily, then 2 weeks) on the inguinal WAT (iWAT) transcriptome versus room-temperature control iWAT (S2.1.p1, S4.4.p1)
final.sample_inclusion: iWAT series S2: control (S2CNT_1/2) and swimming (S2SWIM_1/2); CL316243 and 7-day cold iWAT share the same control and are the paper's other browning arms. BAT series (S3, S5) are separate experiments (BAT whitening at 30C, BAT cold activation) with their own controls and are not part of the exercise estimand.
planned_contrasts: iWAT swimming vs iWAT control (S2.2.p1; paper: 673 up + 826 down mRNAs)
iWAT 4C 7d cold vs control (S2.2.p1; paper: 1062 up + 1201 down) - other browning arm, exploratory here
iWAT CL316243 vs control (S2.2.p1; paper: 837 up + 681 down) - other browning arm, exploratory here
final.repeated_measure_unit: none; each library is a pool of 4 independent mice (S4.2.p1); 2 pools per condition
final.paper_results: Exercise iWAT: 673 up / 826 down mRNAs; induction of Ucp1, Elovl3, Cidea and mitochondrial genes across browning conditions (S2.2.p1, S1E Fig); GSEA GOBP up: cellular respiration, BAT gene set; down: immune processes, WAT gene set (S1F Fig)

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: S2.1.p1/S4.4.p1 describe the swimming protocol and the three iWAT browning arms sharing one control; S2.2.p1 gives the per-arm DEG counts with the threshold (|FC|>=2, FDR<=0.05); S4.3.1.p1 gives Cufflinks/Cuffdiff on FPKM; S4.2.p1 says each sequenced sample is a pool of 4 animals. GEO titles iWAT_Control_1/2 and iWAT_swimming_1/2 match.

checks: FN.p1 and S4.2.p1 name GSE86338 as the study's deposit
18 GEO samples = 18 samples in the paper's PCA (S2.4.p1)
GSE86338_gene_fpkm.txt.gz columns S2CNT_1..S5BAT_WT_COLD_3 equal the metadata description field 18/18
data_processing: TopHat-2.0.9 + Cufflinks-2.1.1 FPKM, matching S4.3.1.p1

ownership.reasoning: Series is cited by the paper, sample count and processing match, matrix columns match metadata description exactly.

exclude_samples.GSM2300503: BAT experiment (S3CNT_1), separate tissue/control; not part of the iWAT exercise estimand
exclude_samples.GSM2300507: BAT control for cold (S5BAT_WT_1), separate experiment
exclude_samples.GSM2300508: BAT control for cold (S5BAT_WT_2), separate experiment
exclude_samples.GSM2300509: BAT control for cold (S5BAT_WT_3), separate experiment

alignment.reasoning: Matrix columns equal metadata 'description' 18/18 (inspect alignment_keys). Group derived from GEO title. BAT samples belong to different experiments with their own controls (S2.3.p1) and are excluded; comparisons never cross tissue.

matrix.reasoning: File name gene_fpkm, data_processing states Cufflinks FPKM, values are non-integer (integer fraction 0.52 driven by zeros), median 0. Paper input for Cuffdiff was the read alignments; counts were not deposited. Linear normalized expression -> log2(x+1) then limma per policy.

final.analysis_type: multi-level one control (iWAT browning arms vs shared control)

candidates.value: two-group SWIM vs CNT fit on 4 samples only
candidates.reason_rejected: residual df = 2; kept only as a sensitivity run. The paper's Cuffdiff run models all iWAT conditions together, so a one-model fit over the 4 iWAT groups (df = 4) is closer.

candidates.value: include BAT samples in one model
candidates.reason_rejected: different tissue and experiments with their own controls; comparisons must not cross tissue

design.reasoning: One control (CNT) with three iWAT treatments sharing it (S2.1.p1): one model, planned contrasts, no pooling of arms. Exercise contrast is primary; cold and CL arms are exploratory context for the paper's counts. Each arm has n=2 pooled libraries -> exploratory label per contract.

confounding_candidates: library_strategy (CL samples labelled RIP-Seq in GEO; mislabel, see discrepancies)
basecalling Casava 1.5 vs 1.9 (constant within iWAT series S2)
covariance.reasoning: Each library is an independent pool of 4 mice; no subject repeated across conditions. All iWAT samples share age annotation (16 weeks), basecaller (Casava 1.5) and series S2. The RIP-Seq label on the CL samples is a GEO annotation error (the paper sequenced polyA RNA for all browning arms) and is aliased with grp, so it is not modelled.

final.method: limma (limma-trend on log2(FPKM+1)), one model ~ grp over the 8 iWAT samples

paper_route.reason: only FPKM matrices deposited; no BAM/read counts in GEO supplementary; Cuffdiff needs alignments

deviations: limma on log2(FPKM+1) instead of Cuffdiff
matrix holds all Ensembl genes (incl. small RNAs, pseudogenes); paper counts are mRNAs only
no low-expression filter (runner filter is for raw counts only); Cuffdiff tests only genes passing its own OK status

method.reasoning: Matrix policy: FPKM -> log2(x+1) -> limma. Paper route blocked by missing alignments; never round FPKM into counts.

final.deviation_note: Paper rule (FDR <= 0.05 and |FC| >= 2, S2.2.p1) applied to limma BH-adjusted p on the deviation route.

threshold.reasoning: S2.2.p1: absolute fold-change >= 2-fold, FDR <= 0.05 -> padj <= 0.05 and |log2FC| >= 1 (inclusive).

final.exploratory_reason: each arm has 2 pooled libraries (< 3 replicates); residual df = 4 in the joint iWAT model
caveats: n = 2 pooled libraries per arm (each a pool of 4 mice): pooling removes biological variance, so p-values understate between-animal variability
swimming mice have no sham-handling/water-exposure control; control is the shared room-temperature iWAT control
FPKM-based limma vs paper Cuffdiff; counts cover all Ensembl genes, paper counts are mRNAs

study.reasoning: Paper route blocked (no alignments); limma on log2 FPKM runs as a declared deviation. Paper counts from S2.2.p1 (up+down). Named genes from S2.2.p1 (induced across browning conditions).

discrepancies.data: all iWAT samples annotated 16 weeks old
